sentences: Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to schedule a meeting.
I would like to reschedule our meeting.
Can we push the meeting back?
I look forward to your reply.
Let me know what you think!

grammar.title: Formal vs. Informal Language
rules: Emails formais usam "Dear", "I am writing to..." e "I look forward to...": Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to schedule a meeting.
Emails informais usam "Hey", contrações e linguagem direta: Can we meet tomorrow?
Verbos formais têm equivalentes informais: reschedule ↔ push back; postpone ↔ put off.
